item.title: Show HN: Built my 15-year-old game idea
item.summary: Especially need help testing the balance of immutable distros. Distro Fighter: WARS - is in closed beta, but HN users get their own key: https://distrofighter.com/wars?beta=hackernews-2026 The arcade at https://distrofighter.com is open to everyone. Promotions happen at midnight tonight (weekly) and the seasons (migration) are quarterly. With a massive surprise at the end of each year.
